name: station-evaluation
description: Run a robot or agent policy through a SmartCiti.X Holodeck station in simulation on the real procedure engine and get the engine's summary: score, stars, unsafe actions, holds broken, pass or fail, deterministic for a seed. Evidence of a procedure under this engine's scoring, not a certification.
